title: 第9章 潜龙在渊第10章 君子之约
content_zh:
讲堂之内，胡教习讲完了令人胆寒的法度，重新端起早已凉透的茶盏润了润喉，翻开了书页的后半部分。
“法度既明，便说回术法本身。”
他的声音平淡了许多，透着一股例行公事的倦怠。
“尔等皆修民生术，虽无杀力，却讲究个‘精微’二字。”
“先说这《行云术》。许多人以为行云便是以元气生风，如赶羊般硬推着云走。大谬！简直是荒天下之大谬！”
胡教习眼皮微抬，手中朱笔在空中随手勾勒出一道蜿蜒线条，化作淡淡水墨烟云，在讲台上盘旋
“云者，水之气也；行者，意之动也。
若要云动，先要气虚。
所谓‘虚室生白，云从龙游’。
你们要在经脉中构建出‘低压’之势，让天地元气自然流向那处空缺，云气自然便会被吸附过去。顺势而为，方为道法自然。”
台下一片沙沙的落笔声，学子们恨不得把每一个字都刻进脑子里。
“再说《唤雨术》。”
胡教习并未停顿，继续念经般说道，眼神却有些飘忽，似乎在想着下值后去哪里饮一杯灵酒
“雨非无根之水，乃是天地交感之泪。
二级唤雨，难点不在于‘唤’，而在于‘锁’。
坎离交济，锁水于空。
你们需以神念为网，锁住云中暴躁的水汽。待到饱和之时，轻轻一点‘震’位，引动雷音，雨便如珠落玉盘，精准润物。”
“至于《驱虫术》……”
胡教习顿了顿，目光漫不经心地扫过角落里的苏秦，随口道
“这就更简单了。

万物皆有灵，虫豸虽微，亦有魂火。
一级驱虫是‘惊’，以气冲之；二级驱虫是‘灭’，以频震之。
找到那虫豸魂火跳动的频率，以元气共振，同频则碎，异频则安。
这其中的分寸，全在神念的敏锐，不可言传，只可意会。”
说完这几句玄之又玄的口诀，胡教习便闭上了嘴，端起茶盏，一副“懂的自懂，不懂拉倒”的模样，再无深入讲解的意思。
台下，赵立握着笔的手有些发白，指关节都泛着青色。
“虚室生白？坎离交济？同频共振？”
他盯着纸上那些墨迹未干的字，眉头锁成了“川”字，眼中满是迷茫与无力
“这每一个字我都认识，可连在一起，怎么就像是听那无字天书？这‘意之动’到底是个什么动法？这看不见摸不着的‘频率’又该如何捕捉？”
旁边的王虎更是把笔一摔，在那张胖脸上狠狠揉搓出一团红印，颓然叹道
“完了，又是这套老词儿。
听了三年了，每次听都觉得云里雾里，像是在抓一阵风。
这哪里是讲课，分明是在打哑谜！
若是悟不到那一点灵光，这辈子怕是都卡在聚元一层，连雨点子都唤不下来几滴，只能在这泥地里打滚了。”
周围几名外舍学子也是一脸苦相，这种需要极高悟性和天赋去参透的“玄机”，正是阻挡他们这些凡夫俗子晋升的天堑。
【听取名师讲道，若有所悟，对《驱虫术》理解加深。】
【经验值+5】
苏秦瞳孔微缩。
涨了？
仅仅是听了几句口诀，连手都没动一下，经验值竟然直接涨了5点？！

要知道，他平日里辛辛苦苦在田里施法两三次，也不过才涨1点经验。这一句话的功夫，竟然顶得上他平日里施法五次！
“原来如此……”
content_en:
In the lecture hall, Professor Hu finished the frightening test, picked up the already cold tea cup again to moisten his throat, and opened the second half of the page.
"Now that the law is clear, let's talk about the magic itself."
His voice was much calmer, with a sense of routine weariness.
"You all practice people's livelihood skills. Although you are not lethal, you pay attention to the word 'subtle'."
"Let's talk about the Art of Moving Clouds first. Many people think that moving clouds means using vitality to generate wind, pushing the clouds away like a sheep. What a big mistake! It's the biggest mistake in the world!"
Hu Jiaoxi raised his eyelids slightly, and the ink pen in his hand casually sketched a winding line in the air, which turned into a light cloud of water and ink, hovering on the podium.
"Clouds are the air of water; walking are the movement of thoughts.
If you want the clouds to move, you must first be deficient.
As the saying goes, "The empty room becomes white, and the clouds follow the dragon's movement."
You need to create a 'low pressure' trend in the meridians, allowing the vitality of heaven and earth to naturally flow to that void, and the clouds will naturally be absorbed there. Just follow the trend and follow the natural way. "
There was a rustling sound of pen writing in the audience, and the students wanted to carve every word into their minds.
"Let's talk about "Rain Calling Technique" again."
Hu Jiaoxi did not pause and continued to speak like a mantra, but his eyes were a little wandering, as if he was thinking about where to drink a glass of spiritual wine after his shift.
“Rain is not rootless water, but the tears of heaven and earth.
The difficulty in level two rain summoning is not in ‘calling’, but in ‘locking’.
The bridges are separated from each other, and the water is locked in the air.
You need to use your spiritual thoughts as a net to lock the violent water vapor in the clouds. When it reaches saturation, gently tap the 'shock' position to trigger the sound of thunder, and rain will fall like beads on a jade plate, moistening things precisely. "
"As for "Anthelmintics"..."
Hu Jiaoxi paused, glanced casually at Su Qin in the corner, and said casually
"This is simpler.
All things have spirits. Even though insects are tiny, they still have soul fire.
The first level of insect repellent is "shock", which is used to flush the insect away; the second level of insect repellent is "destroying", which is used to shock the insect with frequency.
Find the beating frequency of the insect soul fire, and resonate with the vitality. The same frequency will break, and the different frequency will make it safe.
The propriety in this all depends on the sensitivity of the mind, which cannot be expressed in words, but can only be understood. "
After saying these mysterious and mysterious formulas, Hu Jiaoxi closed his mouth and picked up the tea cup, with a look like "If you understand, you will understand, but if you don't understand, you will throw it away", without any intention of explaining in depth.
In the audience, Zhao Li's hand holding the pen turned a little white, and his knuckles were glowing blue.
"The empty room is white? Is there a conflict between obstacles and obstacles? Resonating with the same frequency?"
He stared at the still-dry words on the paper, his brows furrowed into the character "Chuan", his eyes full of confusion and powerlessness.
"I know every word of these, but when they are put together, why is it like listening to the wordless heavenly book? What kind of movement is this 'movement of intention'? How can I capture this invisible and intangible 'frequency'?"
Wang Hu next to him dropped his pen, rubbed a red mark on his fat face, and sighed dejectedly.
“It’s over, it’s the same old words again.
I have been listening to it for three years, and every time I listen to it I feel like I am in a fog, like I am catching a gust of wind.
This isn't a lecture, it's clearly a riddle!
If you don't realize that little bit of spiritual light, you will probably be stuck on the Juyuan level for the rest of your life, unable to summon even a few drops of rain, and you will have no choice but to wallow in the mud. "
Several lay students around him also had grimaces on their faces. This kind of "mystery" that requires extremely high understanding and talent to penetrate is the natural barrier that prevents ordinary people like them from advancing.
[Listen to the sermons of famous teachers, and if you have some enlightenment, your understanding of "Anthelmintics" will be deepened. 】
[Experience value +5]
Su Qin's pupils narrowed.
Increased?
Just after listening to a few formulas, without even moving a hand, the experience value increased by 5 points? !
You know, he worked hard in the fields to cast spells two or three times on weekdays, but he only gained 1 experience point. The effort of this sentence is actually equivalent to the five times he casts spells on weekdays!
"I see……"
